sourceAttribution.impact: The reported 248ms is a browser-page long task whose start falls inside the ingestion observation window. It is not time spent constructing fixture strings in the Playwright Node process. The observer has no call-stack attribution, so the receipt cannot identify which page task caused the 248ms.

sourceAttribution.finding: Setup/hydration work is outside each ingestion window: authentication, room joins, the 100000-row seed, initial rows, roster checks, and the 50-key input cohort complete before the first cycle timestamp. The separate IndexedDB batch benchmark runs after all five cycles.
sourceAttribution.impact: Candidate40 datasetPreparationMs=36383 is not included in the per-cycle long-task sample. The 248ms value still aggregates any browser-page long task beginning after cycle start and before that cycle sample is read, including app event handling/rendering and other page work in that bounded window.

sourceAttribution.finding: Raw heap samples are CDP Performance.getMetrics JSHeapUsedSize values read after each cycle sample; cycle3 and cycle5 values are the endpoints of the reported formula. The explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage runs only after all cycles, after navigating away for cleanup.
sourceAttribution.impact: The 75.4109479% result is consistent with captured raw heap values and is not a retained-after-GC measurement. Natural collection/heap growth can affect it; the post-cleanup GC result does not alter the earlier cycle snapshots.

sourceAttribution.finding: No source-proven attribution/measurement defect was found that would invalidate the candidate40 desktop 248ms page-task maximum, 50/50 input cohort, or raw cycle3-to-cycle5 heap calculation.
sourceAttribution.decision: No scratch tool patch prepared. Do not change workload, thresholds, deadlines, GC placement, or baseline on this evidence.

limits: The full paired receipt is observed-with-open-failures. Candidate24 produced no rows: desktop failed exact item999 after 10,000ms, and mobile hit the 180,000ms Playwright timeout after dataset-ready. Candidate40 mobile failed exact item499 after its 10,000ms locator timeout (2.6m test duration); this differs from the baseline mobile timeout. Candidate40 values are not a before/after comparison.

The candidate40 measurement runner exited 1 after persisting the terminal receipt due to its final json.dumps flush TypeError. The terminal checkpoint binds both result receipts and records sourceUnchanged=true. Do not rerun the lanes to repair that print error.
This is source attribution of existing receipt values only; it does not establish which exact application function produced any long task or establish a heap leak.
verdict: Measured cost attribution is source-consistent: 248ms is a browser-page long task inside the ingestion window; 75.4109479% is uncollected raw JS heap growth from cycle3 to cycle5. No remaining measurement bug is proven. Baseline failure leaves comparison unavailable.
